scenarios.title: Local service without supplied media
scenarios.brief: Create a high-design landing for a trusted local craft/service business with no supplied photography. Use honest conceptual or representative generation without inventing the owner, premises, clients or completed work.

scenarios.title: Redesign with existing identity
scenarios.brief: Redesign a weak landing whose logo, colors, typography and current CSS are available. Treat them as evidence, decide what to preserve or evolve, and do not confuse existing usage with correct direction.

scenarios.title: Institutional event without bureaucratic styling
scenarios.brief: Create an employment and entrepreneurship event landing for a public institution. It must feel trustworthy and accessible while exceeding the conventional institutional microsite through specific art direction.

scenarios.title: Technology product with demonstrable mechanism
scenarios.brief: Create a product landing for a technical tool whose value is a transformation process. The defining visual mechanism must explain the product rather than decorate a generic SaaS hero.

scenarios.title: Editorial and cultural landing
scenarios.brief: Create a culturally authoritative landing where typography, image sequencing and reading rhythm carry the experience without sacrificing mobile comprehension.

scenarios.title: Immersive material transformation
scenarios.brief: Create a landing about physical material transformation. Compare static layers, motion and 3D honestly; keep the least complex implementation that preserves the explanatory and perceptual gain.
